description: The chart illustrates performance metrics for several sentence-embedding model variants by showing three measures per model: Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy. The horizontal axis contains five categorical model settings ordered left to right as Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, (a fourth category whose label is not visible in the image), and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy / Correlation” and uses a linear numeric scale from 0 to 0.9 with major tick marks at 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each category has a grouped set of three adjacent bars: a light cream bar for Sentiment Acc., a pink bar for STS Corr., and a light blue bar for Paraphrase Acc., as indicated by the legend at the top. Approximate values by group are: Single-task_baseline shows Sentiment Acc. around 0.53, STS Corr. around 0.50, and Paraphrase Acc. around 0.79; Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout shows Sentiment Acc. around 0.52, STS Corr. around 0.58, and Paraphrase Acc. around 0.78–0.79; Unsupervised_SimCSE shows Sentiment Acc. around 0.52–0.53, STS Corr. around 0.72, and Paraphrase Acc. around 0.77–0.78; the unlabeled fourth category shows Sentiment Acc. around 0.49, STS Corr. around 0.80, and Paraphrase Acc. around 0.78; and 2-Tier SimCSE shows Sentiment Acc. around 0.49, STS Corr. around 0.81, and Paraphrase Acc. around 0.78–0.79. The bars are not visually annotated with exact numbers and do not appear to be sorted by bar height; no individual bars are highlighted beyond the consistent color scheme.
